features.name: Get Hit
features.description: Reads a key that is already present and returns the entry the cache holds.

features.name: Get Miss
features.description: Reads a key that is absent and reports the absence without allocating an entry.

features.name: Set
features.description: Stores one entry under a fresh key with a ten-minute lifetime.

features.name: Get Or Create
features.description: Reads a present key through the read-through API, so the value factory must not run.

features.name: Expiration
features.description: Stores an entry with a fifty-millisecond lifetime, waits for it to elapse, then reads it.

features.name: Invalidate
features.description: Removes a present key and confirms the entry is gone.

features.name: Concurrent Get Or Create
features.description: Eight threads ask for one absent key at the same time; the value factory must run exactly once.

features.name: Fail Safe
features.description: Serves the last known value when the value factory throws after the entry expired.
features.reason: With this few rated entrants, the reference is a library's own result, not a result earned against a competitor, so the full 200 points would not reflect a win.
